items.text: Never have I ever posted a selfie and deleted it within a minute
Never have I ever liked my own post
Never have I ever stalked an account for hours
Never have I ever accidentally liked an old photo of someone
Never have I ever posted a photo with a filter I regret
Never have I ever sent a story to the wrong group
Never have I ever unfollowed a friend
Never have I ever posted a day in my life video
Never have I ever written a caption that took longer than the video
Never have I ever made a fancy dinner look like a home-cooked meal online
Never have I ever made a fake account
Never have I ever cried at an online video
Never have I ever been tagged in a photo I wish I wasn't in
Never have I ever read the full terms and conditions
Never have I ever deleted an app and come back to it a day later
Never have I ever commented on a post from years ago by accident
Never have I ever used a sound I did not understand
Never have I ever posted a meme and regretted it
Never have I ever had a post go viral
Never have I ever set a screen-time limit and broken it the same day
Never have I ever been messaged by a bot
Never have I ever blocked a family member
Never have I ever started a challenge that flopped
Never have I ever sent a screenshot of a private chat to someone else
Never have I ever made a reaction video
Never have I ever photographed my food for a post before eating it
Never have I ever bought something right after seeing an ad
Never have I ever typed a long post and deleted it
Never have I ever been called out for an old post
Never have I ever accidentally shared my location
Never have I ever made a playlist with a public name I regret
Never have I ever shared a group photo without asking first
Never have I ever gone live by accident
Never have I ever taken a photo just for the background
Never have I ever recorded a voice note longer than three minutes
Never have I ever edited a single photo more than ten times
Never have I ever sent a voice note to the whole group by mistake
Never have I ever kept a post up for a year because I liked how it looked
Never have I ever ghosted a group chat
Never have I ever received a message from a stranger that made my day
Never have I ever been called a main character by a friend
Never have I ever posted a photo of someone without them knowing
Never have I ever planned an outfit around a photo
Never have I ever watched the same video twenty times in one day
Never have I ever shared a news story without reading it
